about: How a transfer ended, as a formlogic.realtime.transfer_outcome frame on the call's realtime stream. It is sent only on a session that negotiated transfer_v1. callId and generation are those of the session, like every frame. atMs is Unix epoch milliseconds at which the plugin decided the outcome. message is only ever on declined: the owner's own words for the caller, at most 320 characters, control markers stripped, untrusted. A completed takeover sends no frame: the session stops with reason handoff:takeover instead. accepted is sent at the accept, before the media setup that follows (up to 45 s, and it can still fail); on it the agent says one short fixed line and then nothing more until the stop or an unavailable outcome (transfer-v1.md).

cases.name: an owner endpoint accepted (sent at the accept, before the media setup that follows, up to 45 s)
an owner endpoint declined and left no message
an owner endpoint declined with a message for the caller

frame.message: Sorry, I am on a job. Please ring after five.

cases.name: the media setup failed and the caller is back with the AI
nobody answered inside the ring window
the caller hung up, consent was withdrawn, or the request was withdrawn

timings.ringSeconds: The host's plan, clamped by the plugin to 20..90 s (the design's default is 40).
timings.outcomeBound: Every request ends in one outcome (or a completed takeover) within ringSeconds + 45 s + 10 s of grace; the plugin's own monotonic deadline is 5 s after that.
